headlines.description: Leeds sent sorry Newcastle spinning to a 4-1 defeat at Elland Road to extend their unbeaten Premier League start and climb to third in the table.

Carlos Espí tapped in a stoppage-time winner -- from a Kylian Mbappé assist -- as Real Madrid won 3-2 at Elche after letting slip a two-goal lead to climb level on points with Barcelona at the top of LaLiga.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mbappé scores, sets up winner as Madrid top Elche
